caption: The drawing features three main views of a handheld object resembling a decorative hand mirror or plaque with a handle, rendered in shades of gray and black pencil. The primary and largest view, located at the bottom right, is a three-quarter perspective showing a sculpted, raised-relief portrait of a man in profile, set within a frame that is shaped with a pointed arch at the top. The handle is elongated, featuring subtle grooves and a decorative end with two rounded tips. The object stands on two short legs attached perpendicularly to the frame's lower edge. Above, there is a top-down plan view of the object, showing the shape and inner structure of the frame, as well as the position of the portrait. To the left of this plan view is an orthographic side view, illustrating the profile and the height provided by the legs. Directly below the side view, there is a small inch scale labeled from 0" to 4". The composition is neatly bordered by a thin rectangular line, and there is a small signature in the bottom right corner of the page. The background of the drawing is off-white, and there are a few small brown spots visible near the center and the upper right corner.
title: George Washington Flat Iron Stand
